_comment: Floor layout (see include/FloorGen.h). The floor is a grid of tiles that starts solid; rooms from config/rooms/*.room are stamped into it and connected with corridors. room_attempts is how many placements are tried before giving up, room_target how many are wanted. corridor_half: a corridor is (2*half + 1) tiles wide. tile_size 32 against the 1280x720 internal render gives 40x22 tiles on screen -- the close, room-at-a-time framing this game wants -- while the buffer still upscales by a clean integer. Chunkiness comes from the TILE, not from starving the framebuffer. SIZE: a dug chamber is one fight, not a level -- about two screens across, so the swarm finds you rather than you hunting it through empty corridor. The gadget will scale this with depth. spaced_markers: placement rules for marker letters that are SPAWNERS -- they keep a minimum distance from the spawn (nobody should surface next to the way in) and from each other; a marker violating the rule is dropped, but a floor always keeps at least one (the farthest from the spawn), because a chamber with nothing seeping is not a chamber. seep_types: what kinds of hole this floor can open -- one is rolled per spawner marker, deterministically from the floor's seed, so a layout is the same holes every time it is generated. marker_seeps pins a letter to a seep kind -- an authored room can say THIS spot is a mouse hole; plain P still rolls from seep_types. descent.act_every is where the delta NARROWS: every nth depth is one floor that every branch above it leads into, so the descent converges on its root instead of widening forever. 0 turns convergence off.
